page.layout: One printed page, a diagram of a circle with letters and handwritten labels in the middle; full-width text above the diagram (one line); below the diagram one block of text with a marginal word "Orienta" at its end; right margin has a stamp-like marking (not transcribed).

main_text.p: Cuius rei causa est tantum tumor terrae,
Si terra profundo esset excauata alueo, & alto undiq; septa cinctaq; ambitu, stellae eleuatae prius Occidentalibus obijcerentur, tardius multo Orienta-
SEPTENT: N R C O P MERIDI: (handwritten labels on the diagram, reproduced as they appear in the figure)

page.notes: The circular diagram carries printed letters Z, B, D, H (Horizon), and the compass letters are partly handwritten in red ink: "SEPTENT", "MERIDI", and letters N, R, O, P, C. The letter "Horizon" appears printed near the centre-left. The text line "Orienta-" ends the paragraph with a hyphen. The faint right-margin mark and the rcin.org.pl watermark are not printed text and were left out. Several words of the diagram captions are uncertain.
